title: RIGG
description: A full-stack SaaS platform for browser-based 3D animation and pose editing. Users can load skeletal models, manipulate bone transforms in real-time, and collaborate on shared sessions — all gated behind a Stripe subscription.
keyFeatures: Real-time 3D bone transform editing with Three.js and GLB/GLTF model support
Subscription-based access control via Stripe Checkout and Customer Portal
Collaborative sessions with live pose sync over SignalR hubs
Cloud file storage on Cloudflare R2 with 15-minute presigned URLs
Full Aspire-orchestrated stack with PostgreSQL, Redis, and containerised services

title: AutoColouringPage
description: A free, browser-based AI tool that converts photos and illustrations into printable colouring page line art. All processing runs client-side via an ONNX neural network — no images are ever uploaded to a server.
keyFeatures: Client-side ML inference using ONNX Runtime Web — fully private, no server uploads
Web Worker architecture keeps the UI responsive during heavy model processing
Tile-based inference with weighted blending handles large images without seams
Adjustable line threshold slider for bold or fine output
Download as PNG or send directly to printer

title: Below the Couches
description: A 2D puzzle game built in Unity using C#. It's a challenging puzzle game that involves creative problem-solving and fun mechanics.
keyFeatures: Implemented complex physics-based puzzle mechanics
Designed intuitive user interface for game controls
Developed custom 2D collision detection systems
Created engaging visual feedback and animations

title: Lyrical Project
description: A full-stack web application that uses AI to generate piano roll music, built with SQL, Node, Flask, React, and Tone.js.
keyFeatures: Integrated AI for music generation capabilities
Built real-time audio processing with Tone.js
Developed RESTful API for data management
Implemented full-stack architecture with React frontend

title: Portfolio Site

keyFeatures: Created responsive design for all device sizes
Implemented smooth animations and transitions
Built reusable React components architecture
